answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1446 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the echo. Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the quartz queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier continues earning. The voyage index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. That is 13 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
